subject: Network & air-gap feasibility — VentureLane next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Lowe <hannah@venturelanehealth.com>; Rajiv Patel <r.patel@venturelanehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Network & air-gap feasibility — VentureLane next steps

Hannah / Rajiv,

Thanks again for taking the call today — really appreciate the clear articulation of the constraints. Below is a short recap of what we heard and proposed next actions so we can align internal ops and legal before sending a first-draft SOW.

Summary of pain points & goals
- Data residency: PHI must remain in a single AWS account in us-west-2; no cross-region backups unless encrypted and customer-managed keys.
- Network: On-premise gateway required for inference traffic; egress channels must be restricted to named Redwood endpoints.
- Air-gap need: Clinical research environments may require an air-gapped option for model updates and offline deployments for audit-controlled trials.
- Auditability: 7-year retention on telemetry/audit logs for regulatory review; SOC2 evidence required during procurement.

What Redwood can do (high level)
- Private deployment in customer VPC with inbound-only connections from controlled jump-host (recommended for minimal footprint).
- Optional on-prem package: containerized runtime with signed binaries and offline model bundle delivery (manual update process).
- KMS/HSM integration for CMK and audit log forwarding to your SIEM.

Open technical questions (we've attached a short network questionnaire):
1) Can you share the CIDR ranges for the jump-host and any proxy egress points?
2) Will the cluster have access to an internal NAT for package updates, or must all OS-level patches be applied offline?
3) Clarify whether the 7-year telemetry retention is absolute (we have tiered retention options to reduce cost).

Next steps
- Hannah / Rajiv: please fill the attached network questions PDF; add any internal contact for your security team. (Action: VentureLane)
- Ben / Marissa / Tessa: internal alignment on feasibility and pricing impact for offline bundles + air-gap support. (Action: Redwood)
- Target: draft SOW and high-level hosting options spreadsheet by 2027-09-24 EOD.

Attachments: venturelane-network-questions.pdf, redwood-hosting-options.xlsx, draft-sow-template.docx

Thanks — I’ll queue a short follow-up to sync Ben and Marissa after we get the questionnaire back.

—
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(t) 415-555-0142 | tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Redwood — Inference made predictable

From: Hannah Lowe <hannah@venturelanehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <r.patel@venturelanehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Network & air-gap feasibility — VentureLane next steps

Tessa — thanks for the summary, spot on. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) CIDRs: we'll send the ranges but the primary egress will come from a dedicated proxy cluster (we control the NAT). Expect to receive the CIDR file by end of day Thursday.
2) Patch/update model: for the research environment we do need an offline update path. Production can have limited outbound, but that will require customer-managed KMS and allowlist.
3) Telemetry retention: legal is asking for 7 years of redacted telemetry (no raw prompts stored) — can you confirm what you mean by "tiered retention" and whether we can configure policies per tenant?

Also: procurement will need a high-level list of what evidence we can provide (SOC2 report, data-flow diagram, penetration test summary). Can you escalate to security for an evidence pack?

I'll get the filled questionnaire back Wednesday night (PST). Thanks again — excited to see the draft options.

Hannah
Director, Infrastructure & Security
VentureLane Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Network & air-gap feasibility — VentureLane next steps

Looping in quick operational notes before we reply to Hannah: 

- Offline model bundles: ops can sign and ship a model bundle with checksums; will require a small on-prem agent to validate and apply. This adds ~1.5 FTE ops support during onboarding + a one-time engineering effort for the installer. We should surface that in the SOW as a professional services line.
- Retention: we can offer per-tenant retention policies with redaction; legal will need to sign off on a description for the agreement. Cost delta depends on storage tiering (hot vs cold).
- Evidence pack: I’ll ask security to prepare SOC2 extract, recent pentest summary, and a sanitized dataflow diagram. Marissa — can you confirm timelines for evidence?

Will draft the SOW skeleton and hosting-options spreadsheet today and share back for review.

—Ben
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Lowe <hannah@venturelanehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Network & air-gap feasibility — VentureLane next steps

Hannah — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is our hosting options spreadsheet and the short SOW template (drafted with Ben). A few quick notes inline: 

> Telemetry retention: we can set a per-tenant retention policy; we’ll redact user-level textual prompts in the telemetry export but retain token counts, latencies, and request metadata for 7 years in cold storage. This matches what Ben said — final legal wording to follow.

> Offline updates: our recommended approach is a signed artifact + on-prem agent; we’ll include an option in the SOW for an "offline bundle" professional services item and an optional annual support add-on.

Action items (recap)
- VentureLane: return filled network questionnaire + confirm security contact (Hannah). (Due: 2027-09-23 — pending)
- Redwood (Ben/Marissa/Tessa): provide evidence pack (SOC2 extract, pentest summary) and finalized SOW draft. (Target: 2027-09-24 EOD)
- Joint: schedule a 30m follow-up with VentureLane security once evidence pack is ready.

I attached the files to this thread. If you prefer, we can move the SOW into DocuSign once the procurement team confirms the redlines.

Thanks — will follow up this afternoon with the draft SOW link.

—
Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
